title: Program Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Part-Time Program Manager provides operational, coordination, and implementation support across multiple externally funded grants and initiatives. This role supports the Principal Investigator and project teams by managing day-to-day grant activities, coordinating student projects, tracking progress toward deliverables, and ensuring timely and effective implementation of grant-funded programs. The position plays a critical role in translating funded research and community‑based projects into actionable outcomes.

Supervisory Authority

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature And Scope

The Part-Time Program Manager works closely with faculty investigators, students, community partners, and institutional offices to support the successful execution of multiple grants. The role requires strong organizational skills, clear communication, and the ability to manage overlapping timelines across projects focused on research, education, community engagement, and technology innovation.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Coordinate implementation activities across multiple grant‑funded projects
  • Manage project timelines, milestones, and deliverables in collaboration with the PI
  • Track grant activities and document progress for reporting purposes
  • Support day‑to‑day grant implementation and compliance activities
  • Coordinate and manage undergraduate and graduate student projects tied to grants
  • Facilitate regular check‑ins with student teams to monitor progress and provide guidance
  • Support onboarding and coordination of student researchers and interns
  • Maintain organized project documentation and shared resources
  • Assist with preparation of internal updates and external reports
  • Coordinate meetings, workshops, and project‑related events as needed
  • Serve as a liaison between faculty, students, and project partners

Core Competencies

  • Project and program coordination
  • Grant administration support
  • Student supervision and mentoring
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Collaborative and team‑oriented approach

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred
  • Experience supporting grants, programs, or research projects
  • Experience working with undergraduate or graduate students
  • Strong organizational and administrative skills
  • Proficiency with common productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft Office)
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an academic or research environment

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$34.00 Per Hour

Localizado no bairro Santo Antônio, a unidade une a praticidade da vida urbana comestrutura moderna e acolhedora , pensada para garantir conforto, discrição e bem-estar aos pacientes.

Com serviços que vão doPronto Atendimento Psiquiátrico aoCentro de Cuidado Diário , oferecemos soluções completas para o cuidado contínuo em saúde mental — proporcionando mais tranquilidade para os pacientes e suas famílias.

  • Atuar junto às equipes multidisciplinares na área da saúde;

  • Encaminhar demandas da equipe interna junto ao administrativo da instituição;
  • Representar a recepção de pacientes no período noturno e seguir procedimentos administrativos;
  • Atender todas as intercorrências clínicas e psíquicas dos clientes internados;
  • Planejar ações de enfermagem;
  • Implementar ações que promovam a saúde dos pacientes;
  • Promover a saúde bem como, orientar junto aos familiares, o quadro em que se encontram os pacientes;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Formação em Enfermagem com COREN ativo.
  • Experiência em Saúde Mental será um diferencial;
  • Empatia, e boa comunicação;

Informações adicionais

Sobre o processo seletivo:

Aqui na ViV, acreditamos que cada pessoa carrega uma história única, e queremos conhecer a sua. Nosso processo seletivo começa já no cadastro, como um convite para entendermos melhor sua trajetória, sua essência e sua conexão com a nossa cultura.

Na etapa seguinte, nosso time de Gente & Gestão entra em contato para uma conversa leve e acolhedora. Esse é um momento de troca: vamos falar sobre suas experiências, expectativas e o perfil da vaga, além de apresentar a ViV, nossos valores e o caminho do processo. Fique à vontade para tirar suas dúvidas, esse espaço é todo seu.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na ViV :

• Conheça a ViV: entenda nossa atuação na área da saúde, nosso propósito e a forma como cuidamos das pessoas todos os dias.

• Acompanhe nossos canais oficiais e redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre nossa cultura, valores e o jeito ViV de trabalhar.

• Reflita sobre sua trajetória: pense nas suas principais experiências, aprendizados e conquistas, e como elas se conectam com a vaga.

• Durante as conversas, compartilhe suas vivências de forma genuína. Falamos sobre resultados, mas também valorizamos os desafios enfrentados e os aprendizados ao longo do caminho.

Dica ViV: seja você. Compartilhe suas conquistas, aprendizados e desafios da sua trajetória. Valorizamos a transparência, o desenvolvimento contínuo e relações construídas com cuidado.

Desejamos a você um processo leve e uma ótima experiência com a ViV

title: Supervisor de Manutenção
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

À essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Tax Sr. Associate
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Tax Sr. Associate Credit Saison Brazil • Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early‑stage start‑up investment and M&A / joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non‑bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you’re passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi‑cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let’s contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Tax Calculation & Compliance : Expertise in the calculation and review of all major federal taxes : IRPJ / CSLL (Annual / Quarterly Actual Profit Lucro Real and Presumed Profit Lucro Presumido), and PIS / COFINS (Cumulative and Non‑Cumulative regimes).

Deep knowledge of federal withholding taxes (IRRF, CSRF, INSSRF) and their accounting reconciliation.

Experience with tax benefits and fiscal incentives + Tax Credits.

Auxiliary Obligations — Extensive experience in the preparation, review, and timely submission of federal and state Tax obligations, including : DCTF, ECF, EFD Contributions, EFD Reinf, ECD, Per / Dcomp, GIA, SPED Fiscal, E-financeira, Dimp.

Tax Credits & Recovery : Proven track record in identifying and processing tax credits, including claims for undue or overpayment, IRPJ / CSLL negative balances, and PIS / COFINS credits (Restitution and Reimbursement requests).

Audit & Litigation Support — Experience managing the Tax Audit calendar and serving as the primary point of contact for external audits.

Ability to analyze and respond to official notices, subpoenas (intimações), decision‑making orders (despachos decisórios), and internal preliminary tax reviews from the Brazilian Federal Revenue (Receita Federal do Brasil).

Tax Planning & Strategy : Knowledge of Transfer Pricing (specifically for Services) and the ability to act as a Tax Business Partner to internal controls (risk management) and international finance teams (supporting international expansion, and local registration).

Financial Reconciliation — Advanced skill in performing detailed fiscal cross‑checks (ECF x EFD Contribuições x DCTF x Apurações x DARFs) and reconciling tax‑related general ledger accounts (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IRRF, PCC).

Collaboration & Communication — Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative attitude, focused on sharing knowledge, working effectively in a team environment, and ensuring effective internal customer service.

Requirements

  • Over 10 years of progressive experience in the fiscal and tax field, with expertise gained across diverse sectors including Technology / Services and Finance.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Law and specialization / Post‑Graduate certification in Taxation.
  • Advanced proficiency and practical expertise in leading ERP systems.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese & English (both verbal and written).
  • Able to commute to the office in São Paulo a few times a week.
  • Knowledge in Brazilian Tax regulation.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel .
  • Well‑rounded understanding and mindset in corporate governance pertaining to Brazilian central Bank.

Preferred Competencies

  • Process Automation & Design : Experience in the automation of tax and P2P processes (invoice receipt, payment, tax calculation, and ancillary obligations) and in the mapping / design of corporate tax processes and policies.
  • Project Management & Coordination : Demonstrated ability to manage complex tax projects, coordinate team activities, and monitor performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

title: Accreditation Operations Senior Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. The tournament requires a highly coordinated, secure, and reliable accreditation operation across all venues and official facilities. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Operations Senior Manager plays a senior operational leadership role within the FIFA27 Accreditation team, overseeing the coordination and delivery of accreditation operations across the tournament footprint. He/She will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, coordination, and delivery of accreditation operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring consistent, compliant, and high-quality service delivery across all tournament venues and official facilities.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager, and working in close collaboration with FIFA Zürich Accreditation, Technology, Security, Client Groups, and Venue Operations, the role provides operational leadership, governance, and oversight of accreditation centre operations, badge production and distribution, accreditation venue teams, and service delivery standards.

The role provides oversight and guidance to Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators and acts as a senior operational escalation point.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Planning & Management

  • Manage the overall accreditation operations strategy across all tournament venues and facilities
  • Define and implement accreditation operational policies, procedures, workflows and service standards in alignment with FIFA requirements
  • Establish and maintain operational timelines, resourcing plans, and risk mitigation measures.
  • Contribute to tournament readiness activities, including operational testing and scenario planning.

Venue & Facilities Management

  • Plan and oversee the delivery of fully equipped Accreditation Centres, including overlay, FF&E, technology, power, lighting, and connectivity.
  • Supervise the setup, operation, and dismantling of accreditation centres and badge distribution points.
  • Ensure venue teams are trained, resourced, and aligned with central accreditation policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the Accreditation volunteers planning, including shift structures and service levels.
  • Supervise day‑day accreditation centre operations across all venues and facilities.

Badge Production & Distribution Oversight

  • Define requirements and manage procurement of accreditation consumables in line with FIFA27 Inc. standards and timelines.
  • Oversee badge production, quality control, secure storage, logistics, and distribution.
  • Implement robust stock controls, audit processes, and reporting mechanisms across all accreditation facilities.

Team Leadership & Support

  • Lead and manage a team of Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators.
  • Support and guide venue-based accreditation managers, temporary staff and volunteers.
  • Provide training, coaching, and performance oversight to ensure consistent service delivery and operational excellence.

Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Support

  • Act as the final escalation point for complex operational issues related to badge issuance, access rights, or client service.
  • Work closely with the Accreditation Systems, Client Group Managers and Coordinators, Security and Technology teams to resolve operational challenges efficiently.

Compliance, Security & Governance

  • Ensure all accreditation operations comply with FIFA access control policies, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Support venue zoning implementation and access rights validation.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, secure handling of materials, and operational compliance at all times.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track operational performance and provide regular operational updates to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and operational debriefs.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Operations, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in accreditation and/or major event operations.
  • Proven experience managing venue operations and large‑scale logistics in complex event environments.
  • Familiarity with accreditation systems and access control processes.
  • Experience working in multi‑lingual, high‑pressure environments.
  • Experience with FIFA or major international sporting events or with accreditation Systems is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong operational leadership and coordination skills.
  • Excellent organisational and logistical planning skills.
  • High attention to detail and operational discipline.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross‑functional coordination skills.
  • Ability to operate calmly and decisively in time‑critical situations.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Project) and planning tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Knowledge of 3D modelling or planning tools is a plus.

Additional Requirements

  • Eligibility to work in Brazil.
  • Willingness to relocate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the contract.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during critical operational phases.

title: Care Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff \"for fit\" makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.


Here Is What We Offer



  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture


Join Howard University and thrive with us!


Benefits page:


Basic Functions


To provide coordination of client-centered services that link clients with substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health with coordinated care and psychosocial services. Working closely and collaboratively with the HUH inpatient and Consultation‑Liaison and Addiction Medicine Consult services and the ambulatory Mental Health Clinic (Behavioral Health Clinic) teams, the Care Coordinator assesses clients’ needs and support systems; facilitates timely, coordinated access to and continuation of medically appropriate substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health care health and support services; assists in expediting appropriate discharge from inpatient facilities, as medically appropriate, and assists in preventing unnecessary hospitalizations; and establishes and maintains relations with case managers, healthcare providers, social services and other agency representatives to bridge the gaps between health, social service, entitlements and other systems.


Principal Accountabilities



  • Assists in development and implements protocols for coordinating the substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health services for individual clients or patients with substance use or co‑occurring psychiatric and substance use disorders.

  • Provides care coordination services to a caseload of patients/clients, as assigned by the PI, Project Director, or Care Manager Coordinator.

  • Operates as a liaison between the Departments of Psychiatry and Community and Family Medicine.

  • Social Work and the DC Department of Health and other community groups.

  • Ensures that patients receive necessary follow‑up substance use or psychiatric disorder treatment and medical treatments.

  • May accompany patients to the initial or follow‑up visits and may help arrange transportation and scheduling of appointments.

  • Conducts intake and follow up assessments of clients’/patients’ behavioral health and medical/functional status; structural vulnerabilities; psychological; educational; financial; and individual support needs.

  • Reviews all initial client bio‑psychosocial assessments and reassessments.

  • Attends department trainings and meetings relevant in ongoing effort to increase knowledge and skills to work effectively with clients.

  • Attends annual and mandatory compliance Program training, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPPA) Privacy training, maintains adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.

  • Works on behalf of patients receiving medications for opioid use disorder treatment to improve the system of care by identifying service gaps and identifying services that are needed and ensuring that these services are provided in a courteous and dignified manner.

  • Maintains confidentiality of patients, their families and the staff.

  • Performs other related duties as assigned.


Core Competencies



  • Knowledge of the care needed for individuals receiving MOUD or other substance use disorder treatment.

  • Knowledge of community resources to establish referral systems with community agencies to facilitate coordinated management plans for patients and their families.

  • Ability to express ideas clearly using appropriate language in communicating with a wide range of health, socioeconomic, and cultural groups.

  • Competence in both oral and written English.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with clients and their family members and other treatment or service providers; physicians, staff, University and Hospital personnel, and the general public.

  • Proficiency in both oral and written English.


Minimum Requirements


A Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field, or 2 or more years of experience in the field.


Compliance Salary Range Disclosure


$46,700- $52,700

title: CRO Expert
description:
Company Introduction:

Apex is a growing agency focused on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), aimed at boosting client sales without increasing ad budgets. We work with top e-commerce brands to enhance their websites, using data and proven strategies to drive growth.

With a solid record of delivering results, we combine technical skills with a focus on improving user experience. As we expand, we offer opportunities to work with a talented team, solving challenges and applying advanced CRO methods.

If you’re looking to make a difference and help e-commerce businesses grow, alongside a team of driven professionals, consider joining the Apex team.

About the Role

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is responsible for enhancing the performance of our clients’ websites by implementing data-driven strategies that maximize their conversion rates.

This position plays a key role in analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing changes to improve overall site performance. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, web developers, and other team members.

Your responsibilities will include developing Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) strategies for our clients, auditing their websites to identify optimization opportunities, running A/B and multivariate tests to determine the changes needed, and working with our internal teams to execute, monitor, and further improve the results of the optimizations implemented.

Mission Statement:

The primary mission of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is to drive measurable improvements in our clients’ e-commerce website performance by implementing tailored CRO strategies. This will involve working directly on optimizing brand websites and using data-driven insights to enhance user experiences, maximize conversion rates, and deliver real business growth to our clients.

General responsibilities:

The responsibilities of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert include, but are not limited to:

  • Developing and implementing tailored, data-driven backend CRO strategies for our agency’s clients to enhance their website performance and maximize conversion rates
  • Performing thorough brand audits of clients’ websites to identify areas for improvement
  • Conducting in-depth analysis of user behavior using analytical CRO tools, user feedback, heatmaps, and session recordings to identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Designing, executing, and managing A/B and multivariate tests to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of the CRO changes implemented
  • Optimizing brands’ landing and product pages, checkout flows, and overall website architecture
  • Collaborating closely with copywriters, designers, and developers to implement best practices and innovative solutions that enhance the user experience and reduce funnel friction points
  • Monitoring and reporting on the performance of CRO initiatives, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Translating complex data and test results into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for clients to ensure that they can make informed decisions
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest trends and tools in the CRO, e-commerce, and digital marketing industries to continuously refine your own strategies and practices
  • Maintaining thorough documentation of all CRO projects, including test results and client interactions, to track progress and outcomes
  • Assisting in the development of CRO case studies and success stories for marketing purposes

Overall, the Conversion Rate Optimization Expert will play an important role in driving measurable growth for our clients by leveraging data-driven insights to optimize their online presence, enhance user experiences, and ultimately increase conversion rates across their e-commerce platforms.

Position specifications:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position includes committing to the following:

  • Full-time commitment while overlapping with our standard office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Consistently maintaining an average workload of 40 hours per week
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD
  • A 30-day notice period of one calendar month

About You:

Profile:

As our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert, you need to bring a highly proactive and analytical approach to your work. You should be able to work independently with high levels of reliability, transparency, and trust. You also need the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple clients’ CRO strategies with great attention to detail and the required technical abilities. The ideal person for this role is a rational thinker who enjoys problem-solving, who can work fast and efficiently, and who has excellent communication skills. In addition, good organizational, time management, and analytical skills will help you succeed in this position and work well within our team environment.

Availability and consistency are highly important factors for us, so our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert should display these qualities regarding workload commitments and availability during office hours.

Key traits for this position:

You should demonstrate great attention to detail, strong communication skills, as well as excellent analytical, technical, and problem-solving abilities. A sense of proactivity, hunger for growth, and a consistent, highly communicative work ethic will work in your favor. You will also need a forward-thinking approach to anticipate shifts in user feedback and industry trends, and you should be highly adaptable and open to continuous learning to help you stay ahead in the rapidly evolving e-commerce landscape.

Responsiveness and autonomy will be essential traits for this role.

Key requirements:

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position has the following key requirements:

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the CRO field
  • Proven experience in a similar CRO role, specifically within the e-commerce industry
  • A proven track record of improving conversion rates for e-commerce clients
  • Proficiency in analytical tools such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and Convert.com as well as excellent data analysis skills to provide actionable insights to our clients
  • A strong understanding of UX/UI principles and how they affect conversion rates
  • A demonstrated ability to run A/B and multivariate tests from start to finish
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms (such as Shopify, Magento, WooCommerce) and the specific challenges involved in optimizing the user’s experience
  • Being familiar with heatmaps, session recordings, and user feedback tools
  • Strong communication skills for effectively presenting test results and recommendations to the team and the clients (direct client communication will not be a requirement of the role, at least not as originally intended)
  • A proactive attitude with a strong focus on delivering high-quality results
  • Being able to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team
  • Being able to handle multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
  • An excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to finding solutions
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your own time independently and effectively
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (You must be fluent in English, although English doesn't have to be your native language)
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it
  • Must be available and responsive during our office hours (10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UK time)
  • Must be able to consistently work full-time

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for ensuring that all fluid metering systems at FPSO are performed in accordance with the technical requirements and legal deadlines, meeting the requirements outlined in Joint Resolution ANP / INMETRO 01: 2013 (RTM)

  • Participate or assist in metering audits

  • Keep measurement points registered in the SFP (ANP production system) updated
  • Validate offloading measurement reports
  • Verify the operational history of seal removal and installation
  • Verify that the FPSO operator is following calibration plans, uncertainty calculations, and required flow computer upgrades
  • Verify / validate in case of measurement system failure the volume estimate as specified in ANP resolutions
  • Verify / monitor backups of measurement equipment information, fault history, equipment replacement, and parameter changes
  • Carry out the planning and control of the sample collection service for chemical analysis, interface with logistics for loading and unloading materials related to the samples, and, if necessary, validate the results of PVT and chromatographic analysis. After validation, monitor the results/inform the need to update the flow computers
  • Follow up on routines to keep the Metering Management System in operation without non-conformities

Produtor(a) de Conteúdo | Esportes Olímpicos – Redes Sociais (RJ)

LiveMode Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Produtor(a) de Conteúdo | Esportes Olímpicos – Redes Sociais (RJ) role at LiveMode

O que nos move? Claro, a paixão por esportes é indiscutível, mas também somos grandes amantes de inovação constante! Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Nosso objetivo é construir um ecossistema que sustente o esporte nas próximas décadas, integrando o melhor do digital e da TV. É assim que estamos fazendo história e queremos encontrar mais pessoas que acreditem no potencial do que estamos construindo e queiram fazer parte disso.

Agora, imagina você começar a sua carreira trabalhando com esporte e numa empresa que vem transformando esse mercado?

Como Produtor(a) de Conteúdo | Esportes Olímpicos – Redes Sociais (RJ) , sua missão será planejar, organizar e impulsionar a estratégia de conteúdo e relacionamento com atletas olímpicos, garantindo que a produção, as pautas, os cronogramas e as parcerias evoluam com agilidade, qualidade e alinhamento estratégico , impulsionando não apenas nossa presença no mercado, mas também a forma como o esporte é vivenciado globalmente.

Responsabilidades:

  • Produção e Direção de Conteúdo: Criar e adaptar posts, artes, cortes e vídeos para plataformas diversas, garantindo que cada entrega contribua diretamente para nossos objetivos estratégicos de ampliar alcance, relevância e impacto das narrativas olímpicas.
  • Construção de Narrativas Esportivas: Traduzir jogos, estatísticas, bastidores e momentos marcantes em conteúdos criativos e de alta performance, colaborando com múltiplas áreas para fortalecer nossa presença editorial e aproximar o público dos atletas.
  • Promoção de eventos da CazéTV: Cortes de jogos, Transmissões e Programas em conteúdos olímpicos.
  • Edição Ágil e Autônoma: Utilizar ferramentas de edição para entregar materiais com ritmo, precisão e qualidade, apoiando a inovação contínua na forma como produzimos conteúdo.
  • Coberturas em Tempo Real: Acompanhar competições, transmissões e bastidores, garantindo velocidade, coerência editorial e alinhamento ao posicionamento da CazéTV e da LiveMode.
  • Gestão de Plataformas e Performance: Monitorar tendências, métricas e formatos emergentes, propondo otimizações que fortaleçam nossa estratégia de conteúdo em escala.
  • Planejamento Operacional: Organizar pautas, agendas, cronogramas e rotinas de publicação, atuando como peça central do fluxo entre conteúdo, design, hard news e tecnologia.
  • Conexão com Diferentes Times: Design, audiovisual e transmissões, para garantir consistência com uma entrega estratégica.
  • Interação com Projetos de Automação e IA: Contribuir para iniciativas que integrem automação e inteligência artificial aos processos, elevando eficiência e acelerando entregas.
  • Relacionamento com Atletas e Gestão de Parcerias: Acompanhar o dia a dia dos atletas olímpicos, organizar fluxos de entrega, sugerir pautas, orientar a produtora responsável pelas execuções e garantir que as parcerias evoluam dentro dos prazos e expectativas.

Requisitos necessários:

  • Experiência prévia em Social Media, Conteúdo ou Edição: Especialmente em esporte, entretenimento ou mídia esportiva/TV, devido à urgência e à necessidade de ritmo e familiaridade com ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Domínio de plataformas e cultura digital: Entendimento profundo de formatos, linguagem, timing e comportamento das principais redes sociais.
  • Habilidade de edição de vídeo e imagem: Experiência com CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Photoshop e Canva, essencial para entregas rápidas e alinhadas ao padrão de qualidade esperado.
  • Conhecimento e interesse em esportes, especialmente modalidades olímpicas: Fundamental para compreender narrativas, ritmos, temporadas e universos das modalidades e dos atletas.

Diferenciais desejáveis:

  • Experiência com projetos digitais ou cobertura esportiva: Especialmente em ambientes de mídia esportiva, transmissões ou competições.
  • Familiaridade com automações e IA generativa: Para colaborar com fluxos de aceleração e inovação em conteúdo.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado: Útil para interações, pesquisas, compreensão de competições e referências internacionais.

Nossos benefícios:

  • Auxílio Alimentação de R$ 1.250,00 por mês, para utilização em restaurantes, mercados, aplicativos de comida e outros estabelecimentos físicos ou online.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional) caso opte pelo benefício, haverá desconto de 6% do salário bruto, conforme previsto na CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde (Especial – SulAmérica) sem custo mensal para o colaborador, com coparticipação de 10% em consultas e exames. É permitida a inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com custos por conta do colaborador e mesma coparticipação.
  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.
  • TotalPass e Wellhub (opcionais) o colaborador pode escolher a plataforma que melhor atender às suas necessidades. Ambas oferecem acesso a academias de diversas modalidades, esportes variados e aplicativos de saúde física, mental e financeira.
  • Auxílio-Creche para filhos de até 5 anos e 11 meses, com reembolso de despesas em creches, escolas ou com profissional regularizado (babá ou autônomo).
  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico.
  • Seguro de Vida (Prudential) é uma proteção financeira para o colaborador e seus beneficiários em momentos de adversidade. SESC oferece acesso a atividades culturais, esportivas, de lazer, saúde e educação, incentivando um estilo de vida saudável e equilibrado.
  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre. Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

Banco de Talentos de Professores - Os Batutinhas

Banco de Talentos de Professores - Os Batutinhas

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de mais de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 85.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.
Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.
Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.
SOBRE O BANCO DE TALENTOS:
Este banco de talentos é para Os Batutinhas, uma de nossas marcas de escola no Brasil. Somos uma escola com mais de 20 anos de história formando as nossas crianças para saírem preparadas para enfrentar os desafios do Ensino Fundamental, apaixonados por literatura e com prazer de investigar o mundo. Baseado na teoria construtivista, o trabalho d’Os Batutinhas é ancorado na visão de que a criança assume o lugar de protagonista no seu processo de aprendizagem, construindo conhecimentos sobre o mundo e sobre si mesma.
Nossa missão é contribuir para a formação de crianças criativas, éticas e conscientes de seus deveres por meio da ampliação do repertório cultural e da formação contínua da equipe. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.
Se você se identifica com a nossa proposta, se inscreva no nosso Banco de Talentos de Professores para Os Batutinhas e assim que surgir uma oportunidade que tenha a ver com o seu perfil, nós entraremos em contato!
RESPONSABILIDADES
O que nossos professores fazem:

  • Planejam as aulas baseadas em materiais pedagógicos;
  • Ministram aulas;
  • Mediam relacionamento entre alunos, famílias e escola;
  • Preparam avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Participam de reuniões pedagógicas e eventos realizados na escola.
REQUISITOS
O que você precisa ter:
  • Formação adequada para a função que deseja.
Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.
SAFEGUARDING STATEMENT
O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Se você é um Fisioterapeuta que acredita na transformação do cuidado à saúde, venha fazer parte da nossa equipe e ajude a moldar o futuro da saúde no Brasil. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas.

Tem Paixão pelo Cuidado? Então junte-se a nós!

A Laços Saúde está pronta para receber você!

Vamos juntos cuidar da saúde da comunidade!

title: Managing Consultant, Customer Success
description:
Overview

Company Overview
Libryo, an ERM Group Company, is a global SaaS platform that empowers multinational organizations to understand and comply with Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) law and broader ESG requirements. Our platform helps customers navigate complex regulatory environments with clarity and precision. Founded in 2016 and now part of ERM, the world’s largest pure-play sustainability consultancy, Libryo combines technology with legal expertise to support organizations in achieving operational excellence and legal certainty.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) with strong strategic account management expertise to grow a portfolio of customers in North America and Latin America (NA/LATAM). This is a mid-to-senior-level role with potential people management responsibilities. This individual will lead customer implementations, drive platform adoption, and be accountable for renewal outcomes, customer growth opportunities, and relationship longevity. You’ll work across departments to deliver a high-quality experience that aligns with each customer’s business and regulatory objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Regional Account Ownership (NA & LATAM)
    • Serve as the primary point of contact for all assigned customers in North and Latin America.
    • Build and maintain strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, user groups, and decision-makers across large multinational organizations.
    • Represent the voice of the customer internally to ensure customer needs are heard and prioritized.
  • Customer Implementations
    • Lead end-to-end delivery of customer onboarding and implementation projects, coordinating with internal teams (e.g., Legal Content, RIDE, and Product) to deliver on time and to spec.
    • Work with key stakeholders to map customer-specific rollouts (global or phased), track milestones, communicate progress with customers, and resolve blockers proactively.
    • Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practice guides to scale future delivery.
  • Renewal & Retention Management
    • Take full ownership of renewal planning and execution, including pricing alignment, contract coordination, and commercial positioning for their allocated customer portfolio and region.
    • Monitor and improve customer health and adoption through data, feedback, and regular business reviews.
    • Anticipate and mitigate risks that could lead to churn through proactive engagement and problem-solving.
  • Strategic Account Growth
    • Identify and support growth opportunities, including cross-sell, upsell, and feature expansion across accounts.
    • Support proposal creation and commercial scoping efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders to enable account expansion.
    • Track and report on account growth potential using insights from platform engagement, stakeholder behavior, and evolving needs.
  • Platform Mastery & Support
    • As a senior member of the Customer Success team, develop deep expertise across Libryo’s full suite of tools, including the Libryo Platform, Libryo Research, and ERM Assess. Deliver high-level support and guidance to users, ensuring seamless navigation, adoption, and troubleshooting across all platforms. Play a key role in ensuring a consistent, professional, and high-quality user experience across every touchpoint, reinforcing Libryo’s reputation for excellence and reliability in regulatory technology.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination
    • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Legal, Product, Support, Customer Intelligence) to ensure each customer receives seamless, aligned service.
    • Participate in customer health reviews, product feedback loops, and ongoing support escalations when needed.
    • May manage and mentor junior Customer Success team members, contributing to team strategy and development.
  • Customer Reporting & Communication
    • Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with strategic insight, platform metrics, and tailored recommendations.
    • Maintain CRM hygiene in HubSpot, ensuring accurate tracking of org structures, usage data, and renewal timelines.
    • Provide input to internal reporting (e.g., churn forecasting, customer health scores, and CS dashboards).
  • Experience & Qualifications
    • Fluent in English (additional languages is a huge plus, particularly Spanish).
    • Bachelor's degree in business, legal, environmental sciences, or a related discipline. A legal background is a strong advantage.
    • 5+ years of customer success/account management experience in a B2B SaaS, compliance, legal-tech, or ESG space.
    • Demonstrated success managing strategic enterprise accounts and driving customer growth and renewals.
    • Proven ability to lead complex customer implementations, manage cross-functional projects, and navigate senior stakeholder relationships.
    • Exposure to international accounts, with an understanding of NA/LATAM business contexts and cultural nuance.
    • Strong command of HubSpot, Salesforce, ClickUp, Excel/Sheets, and reporting/BI tools (PowerBI is a plus).
    • Experience managing or mentoring junior team members or working in a leadership pod structure.

What Success Looks Like

  • Highest quality of work delivered
  • High engagement and satisfaction across assigned customer accounts.
  • Successful and on-time delivery of all customer onboarding and implementation projects.
  • Clear account growth paths identified and supported with strategic input.
  • Renewals closed predictably and proactively with limited commercial risk.
  • Clean, current data and insight-driven QBRs shared with customers and leadership.

Platform Expertise & Training

Develop deep knowledge of the Libryo platform and associated tools to support effective onboarding, training, and engagement. Deliver live training sessions and contribute to documentation, including Knowledge Base content for customer self-service.

Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Assist in collecting and analyzing customer feedback and reviewing internal workflows to improve the end-to-end customer journey. Help refine internal operational processes to improve delivery consistency, reduce friction, and ensure high-quality service across customer segments.

Thank you for your interest in ERM!

title: Coordenador de Operações de Transportes - Rio de Janeiro
description:
O Coordenador de Operações de Transportes é responsável por coordenar e supervisionar todas as operações do contrato garantindo que sejam executadas de forma eficiente. Planejar e otimizar cada processo pois o objetivo é maximizar a eficiência operacional e minimizar custos. Os indicadores de desempenho são também sob sua responsabilidade, devendo assim acompanhar essas métricas, identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar ações corretivas para otimizar os resultados. Além disso, é o representante DeLuna como ponto de contato entre a empresa, fornecedores e clientes. Outro aspecto importante é a construção de um ambiente de trabalho positivo e colaborativo, que é essencial para o sucesso organizacional. Estabelecer uma visão compartilhada, construir um ambiente de trabalho positivo, atribuir tarefas de forma equilibrada, incentivar o desenvolvimento dos membros da equipe e demonstrar habilidades de resolução de conflitos e tomada de decisões.

Competências necessárias :

  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e comunicação;
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas de forma eficiente;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e tomar decisões rápidas;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e alto nível de organização;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas da empresa;
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com mudanças e novos desafios.

As principais Responsabilidades incluem:

  • Elaborar Planos de Ações para garantir resultados pactuados no Planejamento Estratégico Empresarial;
  • Acompanhar Indicadores de Desempenho, elaborar processos para melhoria contínua, garantir execução;
  • Assegurar a gestão, implementação e treinamento dos Procedimentos Operacionais;
  • Coordenar Operações Logísticas, bem como projetos e implementações de novas Operações;
  • Garantir resultados pactuados com o Cliente, elevando o nível de serviços e satisfação por meio de alta performance e gestão. Realizar atendimento direto ao Cliente com propósito de melhorar e expandir continuamente as operações de transportes;
  • Maximizar a rentabilidade das operações, acompanhar orçamento e controle agindo para garantir os resultados financeiros pactuados, gerindo processo de perdas e eliminando prejuízos operacionais;
  • Fazer Gestão Estratégica de Pessoas para que todos gerem resultados, buscando o processo de crescimento por meio da evolução dos Colaboradores.
  • Treinar, acompanhar e monitorar desempenho dos Colaboradores da área de Operações: Supervisores, Líderes, Encarregados e Dispatchers. Implementar rotina de Gestão.
  • Fazer Gestão de Relacionamento com os Prestadores de Serviços de Transportes, garantindo a implementação da cultura e requisitos da organização;
  • Acompanhando e auxiliar o processo de captação e retenção de Prestadores;
  • Realizar as Reuniões Matinais com os Prestadores de Serviços.

A Formação necessária para essa função é Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Logística, Engenharia ou afins. Desejável pós-graduação.

Os Conhecimentos necessários são:

  • Experiência comprovada em planejamento estratégico, gestão de operações logísticas e transportes, sendo um diferencial vivência em Last Mile e/ou E-Commerce;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão de transporte (TMS) e ferramentas de rastreamento;
  • Habilidade em análise de dados e geração de relatórios de performance;
  • Conhecimento das regulamentações e normas de segurança no transporte de mercadorias;
  • Capacidade de planejamento e organização para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e prioridades.

Técnico de Manutenção - Volta Redonda / RJ

Manter os equipamentos em perfeito estado de funcionamento, realizar manutenção técnica, limpeza geral, acompanhar terceiros na solução de problemas quando estes fogem de nossa alçada, realizar testes e vistorias frequentes nos dispositivos de segurança, conservar o aspecto visual, iluminação do ponto, implantar melhorias visando a satisfação do cliente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar atendimentos operacionais dos PCs: repor suprimentos, papel e filtro de ar, substituir consumíveis e trocar peças, baixar aplicativos, realizar vistorias dos PCs, verificar se estão em perfeitas condições, acompanhar fornecedores para reparos técnicos, configurar softwares e manter atualizada a comunicação visual do ponto.
  • Reparar e trocar componentes que apresentem defeito no equipamento, identificado por meio de conhecimento técnico. Solicitar peças para a Logística através das ferramentas do sistema ETA e transportadoras.
  • Liberar o ponto para que o responsável pela manutenção (pode ser da concessionária de telecomunicações, empreiteiro, empresa que faz manutenção) possa executar o reparo no defeito.
  • Estar atento aos dispositivos de segurança dos equipamentos, observando se não há tentativas de fraude. Utilizar conhecimentos técnicos sobre o funcionamento do sistema e testes para manutenções quando necessário.
  • Garantir boa sinalização e iluminação dos pontos, aspectos visuais como pintura, adesivos e limpeza, utilizando materiais de limpeza e peças de reposição, além de acionar empreiteiras quando necessário para atividades além do escopo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Escolaridade: Técnico ou superior completo em elétrica, eletrônica, mecatrônica, mecânica, informática ou afins;
  • Conhecimentos de microinformática (hardware e software);

Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As an implementations specialist, you will become an equity expert and use that knowledge to implement our clients onto the Carta software, setting them up for long‑term success. You will work to:

  • Establish strong customer relationships and inspire long‑term loyalty by providing a high quality and timely on‑boarding process as the first service provider post‑sale

  • Train clients on how to use Carta Software: you feel comfortable working with data, business systems, and developing training content for our customers
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on‑boarding process
  • Work closely with product, engineering and our internal implementations leaders to improve the experience for our customers

The Team You’ll Work With

Carta is looking for an Implementation Specialist to join our Rio SMB/MM Team as part of our larger Delivery team. Our Delivery team members have grown to become some of the strongest contributors in our company due to their thorough understanding of our software, customers, and the business value we deliver. Ideal candidates will have a strong passion for financial services, building customer relationships, project delivery, and analytical problem solving.

  • Knowledge of finance and accounting is a plus

title: Technical Services Senior Manager
description:
Technical Services Senior Manager

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.

The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
  • Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
  • Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
  • Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
  • Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
  • Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
  • Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
  • Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or engineering field
  • A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization
  • Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling)
  • Strong technical knowledge in Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling, Entertainment)
  • Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Availability to travel as needed

title: Brazil - Remote: Front-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Complexity: Rendering massive tables and managing strict validation logic for mission-critical data pipelines.
  • Interactivity: Building conversational UIs (streaming chat) and high-performance time-series dashboards that update in real-time.
  • Visualization: Designing intuitive interfaces for Data Lineage, Knowledge Graphs, and Entity Mapping.

You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, ensuring design consistency across the platform while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Component Architecture: Create a reusable, strictly typed Angular component library that scales across AI, Dashboard, and Admin modules.
  • Performance: Optimize change detection strategies and virtual scrolling to ensure the UI remains responsive and performant, whether rendering a live data stream or a 3D object.
  • Data-Driven Design: Handle complex JSON schemas and heavy payloads, ensuring data precision from API to UI

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Data Platform & Management Tools

  • Build Management Interfaces: Develop the "Control Room" for Data Engineers, including Data Catalog and Pipeline Configuration screens.
  • Heuristics & Mapping: Create efficient workflows for "Entity Matching" that allow users to visually map raw sensor tags to physical assets.
  • Visualizing Lineage: Implement DAG visualizations (D3.js or similar) to allow users to trace data asset layers and dependencies.

AI Interfaces & Visualization

  • Build AI Assistant UI: Develop rich conversational interfaces that support streaming responses (SSE), markdown rendering, and interactive "artifacts".
  • Advanced Dashboarding: Implement high-performance time-series charts using Plotly.js, ensuring smooth zooming/panning on large datasets.
  • Document Handling: Develop integrated viewers for PDF documents and rich media, allowing Agents to cite sources visually.

The Technology Stack

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Framework: Angular 16+ (Expert level), TypeScript, RxJS.
  • State Management: NgRx or Signals.
  • Visualization: Plotly.js (Time-series), D3.js/DAGs (Lineage).
  • API Integration: REST APIs (FastAPI), Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets (using Socket.io)

Qualifications

  • Component Architect: You write clean, decoupled components and understand how to build a UI kit that scales.
  • UX Sensibility: You understand that a "Chat" interface needs to feel immediate and care about loading states and smooth transitions.
  • You take pride in building tools that make other engineers productive, caring deeply about workflow efficiency and keyboard shortcuts.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Frontend Development (Angular focus).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and reactive programming patterns.
  • Experience building Admin Dashboards, B2B SaaS interfaces, or complex SPAs.
  • Ability to handle complex API integrations and data modeling on the client side.
  • Advanced English communication skills

Good To Have

  • Visualization: Hands-on experience with Plotly.js, D3.js, or Lineage/DAG graphs.
  • AI/Chat: Experience building Chat/LLM interfaces and handling streaming text.
  • Data Heavy: Familiarity with high-performance libraries and virtual scrolling.
  • Media/Geo: Experience with PDF rendering in-browser or Map/GIS libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox).

Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 26 milhões de pessoas. Somos inspirados a transformar o futuro e melhorar a forma que as pessoas vivem. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos a nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de dezenas de cidades, levando saúde, dignidade e bem-estar.

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizará o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa. A partir de 2020 passou por uma revisão e seu objetivo foi reconfigurado: espelhar a população negra em todos os níveis hierárquicos. Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.

  • Experiência prática com Flutter e Dart (profissional ou equivalente que comprove entregas reais).

  • Experiência com recursos modernos da linguagem Dart e programação assíncrona (Futures, Streams, async/await).
  • Vivência com ferramentas da Firebase Suite: Crashlytics e Remote Config.
  • Conhecimento de Git e rotina de pull request/code review (mesmo que com apoio).
  • Noções sólidas de qualidade : organização de código, tratamento de erros e atenção a performance.
  • Conhecimento básico de testes em Flutter (unit/widget) e boas práticas de desenvolvimento mobile.

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com arquitetura no Flutter (Clean Architecture, MVVM, etc.).
  • Implementação de Design System proprietário, componentes reutilizáveis, tematização
  • Conhecimento de Firebase (Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, Push).
  • Experiência com CI/CD mobile (Fastlane, Bitrise, GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps).
  • Noções de observabilidade e monitoramento em apps.
  • Experiência com app em produção (mesmo que em menor escala).

Informações adicionais

Muita visibilidade e exposição positiva, pra você conseguir se conectar com todo mundo sem muita hierarquia.
