title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.

Team & Contractor Coordination

  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

Your profile

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

A área de IAM é responsável por garantir que cada pessoa e sistema tenha o acesso certo, no momento certo e apenas ao que precisa, usando ferramentas como Entra ID, Active Directory e SailPoint. Ela cuida de todo o ciclo de vida do usuário, desde a criação da conta, mudanças de função, até o desligamento, além de controlar acessos, autenticações e integrações com sistemas internos e SaaS.

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Operar e dar suporte ao ambiente de Identidade e Acesso;
  • Garantir que usuários, sistemas e aplicações tenham os acessos corretos e seguros;
  • Tratar chamados de IAM dentro do SLA de atendimento;
  • Acompanhar e corrigir falhas de provisionamento e desprovisionamento;
  • Apoiar criação, alteração e remoção de acessos no MS Entra ID, Active Directory, SailPoint e aplicações integradas;
  • Executar e acompanhar os fluxos de Joiner, Mover e Leaver;
  • Apoiar revisões de acesso e campanhas de certificação;
  • Testar e validar integrações via SCIM e APIs usando Postman;
  • Rodar e ajustar automações simples em PowerShell;

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD);
  • Experiência com Active Directory (on-premises e híbrido);
  • Conhecimento em Identity Lifecycle Management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver);
  • Conhecimento em processos de provisionamento e desprovisionamento de contas e acessos;
  • Conhecimento em RBAC (controle de acesso baseado em papéis);
  • Noções de auditoria de acessos, revisões e compliance (SoD, Least Privilege);
  • Experiência com Postman para testes e validação de integrações.

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento em SCIM;
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, JSON e Web Services;
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de autenticação e autorização (OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0 e OpenID Connect);
  • Experiência com ferramentas ITSM, como Freshservice;
  • Conhecimento em PowerShell e/ou Python;
  • Experiência com Logic Apps e Azure Functions;
  • Conhecimento em Azure Key Vault (AKV) para gestão de segredos, credenciais e tokens;
  • Conhecimento em workflows, rules e transforms no SailPoint ISC;
  • Experiência com integração de aplicações corporativas e SaaS;
  • Noções de segurança em APIs;
  • Certificações em IAM, Cloud ou Segurança da Informação.

The Software Alliances team at Canonical works with leading software companies to optimize and enable their products with Ubuntu and other Canonical software, for instance our AI offerings.   • Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels.

Nice‑to‑have Skills And Experience

  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.

  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipal, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

BEM-VINDOS À MAIS AMADA DO RIO!

QUEM SOMOS

Somos a Venancio, uma marca carioca que há mais de 46 anos coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz.

Com mais de 140 lojas físicas e mais de 5.000 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios, Volta Redonda, Cabo Frio e São Pedro da Aldeia.

Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora.

Acreditamos que saúde vai além de medicamentos: é sobre qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar.

Em 2014, expandimos nossa atuação com a Hospinova, empresa do Grupo Venancio especializada no mercado hospitalar e distribuição farmacêutica. E para sustentar nosso crescimento, contamos com três Centros de Distribuição estrategicamente localizados no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.

O QUE NOS TORNA ÚNICOS

  • O acolhimento genuíno no atendimento
  • O busca constante por inovação

Valorizamos o capital humano, investimos na capacitação de nossos times e atuamos com ética, transparência e simplicidade. Aqui, cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importa.

E a Venancio não para: até o final de 2025, inauguraremos mais 23 lojas e continuaremos crescendo, sempre com o compromisso de oferecer atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar.

Para levar as melhores sensações aos nossos clientes, precisamos de pessoas que trabalhem realizadas e comprometidas em alcançar a excelência no nosso atendimento. Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha fazer parte desse time que transforma vidas todos os dias.

Our roles are remotely based (even pre‑Covid), meaning you will be working from your home office, connecting with your client and team on a daily basis.

To be successful in this type of environment, you will need to have the ability to communicate effectively (in English) with cross‑functional teams, explain complex concepts in easy, understandable terms, align HR / business knowledge with Workday functionality, and proactively drive process improvements. You will need to be comfortable with video calls and be proactive in keeping communication channels open with your client and team.

Skills and Experience Required

  • 3 - 5 years’ Workday Integration and implementation experience including payroll integrations (either Workday Payroll and/or 3rd party payroll systems);

  • Ability to work independently and cross‑functionally.

Other Qualifications/Skills that will be beneficial but not mandatory

  • College or University Degree in HR or Information Systems.
  • Experience with any of the following: Java, JavaScript, .NET, XSLT, NetBeans IDE development background.
  • Experience in other critical corporate platform implementations such as Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Sailpoint, SAP, Siebel, MuleSoft, Dellboomi, or applications built on AWS services.

As this is a remote role, you can be based anywhere in the Latin America region so long as you are authorised to work without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Senior Accountant, Accruals & Expenses, plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of Howard University’s expense‑related financial activities. This position is responsible for reviewing the accounting worktags on invoices, requisitions and other spending; preparing monthly expense accrual entries; analyzing prepaid expenses, expense activity, and reconciling the related general ledger accounts. The Senior Associate partners with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Capital Projects, Budgets and departmental administrators to ensure that expenses are properly recorded in compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), University policy, and internal control standards. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, excellent problem‑solving skills, sound accounting judgment, and the ability to interpret contracts and operational data to determine proper accounting treatment. The Senior Accountant will also support the monthly, quarterly, and annual close and audit processes.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature and Scope

Internal contacts include staff within the Controller’s Office, Procurement, Accounts Payable, Budget Office, and departmental administrators, and other departments within the university. External contacts include auditors and consultants.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Review the accounting worktags on new invoices, requisitions and other spending to ensure accurate accounting classification and adequate supporting documentation.
  • Prepare monthly accrual entries across administrative and academic units, ensuring accuracy and compliance with GAAP and University guidelines.
  • Maintain detailed accrual schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
  • Analyze expense trends and variances, propose journal entries, and ensure completeness and accuracy of liabilities.
  • Assist with expense‑related budget vs. actual reviews for the Controller’s Office and institutional departments.
  • Prepare and record prepaid expenses and monthly amortization schedules.
  • Maintain and reconcile prepaid expense ledgers for accuracy and completeness.
  • Ensure prepaid transactions comply with the University’s capitalization and expense recognition policies.
  • Prepare journal entries, reconciliations, roll‑forward schedules, and supporting analytics for monthly close.
  • Perform account analyses to identify errors, omissions, or inconsistencies, recommending corrective actions where needed.
  • Support the preparation of quarterly and annual financial reporting focused on accruals, expenses, and liabilities (i.e. variance analysis).
  • Assist with expense recognition assessments, ensuring appropriate accounting treatment.

Contract & Policy Review

  • Review contracts, agreements, purchase orders, and vendor documentation to interpret accounting implications.
  • Conduct accounting research and prepare clear, concise technical memos documenting decisions in accordance with GAAP/FASB.
  • Ensure adherence to university accounting policies, procurement policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Internal Controls, Compliance & Audit Support

  • Ensure accuracy, proper approvals, documentation, and compliance across all expense‑related transactions.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by preparing reconciliations, schedules, and explanations.
  • Help identify gaps in internal controls and suggest improvements to enhance financial accuracy and efficiency.

Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Support

  • Partner with Accounts Payable, Procurement, Capital Projects, Budget, and operational departments to support efficient financial processes.
  • When needed, provide guidance to departments on proper accounting practices, expense classification, and policy interpretation.
  • Assist the Accounting Manager and Assistant Director with special analyses, process improvements, and system initiatives (including Workday enhancements).

Other Duties

  • Perform critical self‑review of work to ensure high quality and accuracy.
  • Support various special projects and other responsibilities as assigned by management.

Core Competencies

  • Strong understanding of GAAP (including accrual accounting and expense recognition)
  • Experience with expense accounting, accruals, reconciliations, and monthly close processes
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (Workday is a plus)
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data analysis, macros)
  • Exceptional analytical, critical thinking and problem‑solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
  • High level of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance
  • Minimum 4–6 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in a complex environment
  • Experience with accounting for accruals and expenses
  • Workday or large ERP system experience strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet strict deadlines.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$105,000-$115,000

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Social Media Strategist plays a critical role in elevating, monitoring, and protecting the Howard University brand across digital platforms. Reporting to the Associate Vice President of Multimedia and Digital Operations in the Office of University Communications (OUC), this position manages the creation and execution of social media calendars, develops content tailored for key audiences, performs social listening and sentiment analysis, and provides governance support for the University’s network of official accounts. This strategist is both a hands‑on creator and a strategic partner, working closely with the office of University of Communication leadership, academic and administrative offices, and digital content teams to ensure consistent storytelling, brand protection, and innovation across platforms.

Supervisory Accountability

May supervise part‑time student employees, fellows, or interns.

Nature And Scope

  • Internal contacts: Campus Partners including faculty, staff, students, administrators
  • External contacts: social media platforms, influencers, media, and the public.

The strategist is expected to operate in a highly visible, high‑volume digital environment while ensuring the University’s online reputation and brand integrity remain strong.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Identify and execute strategies to build Howard University’s visibility and enhance its reputation through innovative use of social platforms.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive social media calendars across flagship channels.
  • Assist with the onboarding of new University social media accounts, ensuring adherence to governance guidelines.
  • Develop, plan, and implement creative programs, campaigns, and engagement strategies to grow audiences and increase impact.
  • Provide timely and accurate social media reporting that highlights KPIs, insights, and recommendations.
  • Support governance tracking, including account audits, policy adherence, and training.
  • Collaborate with Office of University Communications leadership and staff to ensure alignment between institutional priorities and digital storytelling.
  • Recommend new tools, platforms, and technologies (including generative AI) that advance University objectives.
  • Provide training, workshops, or consultative support to internal stakeholders.
  • Manage social communities across all official platforms and foster positive engagement.
  • Support crisis communications management by monitoring trends and providing timely recommendations.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

Knowledge

  • Advanced understanding of major social media platforms, analytics tools, and content formats, with expertise in tailoring content for different audiences.
  • Strong knowledge of online reputation management, governance best practices, and sentiment analysis.
  • Understanding of how generative AI, emerging platforms, and advanced creative tools can be leveraged in higher ed and brand storytelling.

Skills

  • Intermediate to Expert-level proficiency in Canva and strong video editing skills for social platforms (Reels, Shorts, TikTok).
  • Demonstrated ability to design and edit content using professional software (Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, or similar).
  • Strong writing skills with a clear understanding of audience, tone, nuance, and detail (work in multicultural or higher education highly preferred).
  • Creative thinking to help conceptualize campaigns and content that inspire audiences and attract media attention.
  • Strong project management, organization, and reporting skills with a proven ability to juggle multiple deadlines.

Abilities

  • Ability to work under pressure and consistently meet deadlines, including quick‑turn requests.
  • Strong judgment in addressing sensitive issues, crisis situations, and community management.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess social performance, identify opportunities, and deliver actionable insights.
  • Initiative and creativity in generating new content ideas and campaign approaches.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, highly visible, and fast‑paced digital environment.
  • Results‑oriented, resourceful, and enthusiastic with a proactive, solutions‑first approach.
  • Willingness to work nonstandard hours when required for events, emergencies, or priority campaigns.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Advertising, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of progressive experience in digital communications, social media management, or online marketing.
  • Required: high-level to expert proficiency in Canva and social-native video editing.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a high-volume environment and manage multiple projects.

Preferred Requirements

  • Hands‑on experience managing a highly active, high‑reach social platform (university, corporate, entertainment, or public figure).
  • Demonstrated knowledge or high interest of generative AI tools and technologies for content creation.
  • Intermediate to advanced skills in higher‑end editing software (Adobe Premiere or similar).
  • Experience with social media scheduling software (Meltwater, Sprout, Hootsuite, Loomly, Later, or similar).
  • Prior social media experience in higher education, large organizations, or public‑facing institutions preferred but not required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $63,636 - $70,000

This role combines on-the-ground observation, data-driven auditing, and strategic feedback, driving immediate action and long-term improvement in our sales engine.

In this role, you'll be...

  • Design, implement, and own a comprehensive Sales Quality framework, including deep-dive audits, scorecards (technical, behavioral, process, system use), and structured feedback mechanisms.
  • Conduct audits across the commercial journey, observing field visits, CRM/system logs, demos, emails, and adherence to playbooks, to identify deviations and opportunities.
  • Manage with the team, frequent field visits alongside Business Developers to observe live execution, assess coaching needs, and validate actual vs. documented behavior.
  • Analyze usage patterns in CRMs and other commercial tools to detect gaps, underutilization, or misuse, feeding insights back into training, KB, and process improvement.
  • Act as a guardian of excellence: monitor compliance with playbooks, process flow, KB, and use of tools, and ensure alignment for every BD interaction.
  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, Operations, and Tech teams to translate QA findings into enhancements, improving Knowledge Base, training modules, workflows, and system improvements.
  • Produce recurring reports on QA insights, emerging gaps, trends, and prioritized recommendations for rapid corrective action and strategic evolution.
  • Coach and mentor QA Specialists, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, consistency, and data-based quality execution.
  • Advocate for operational, process, and systemic improvements with a hypothesis-driven mindset, strong alignment with broader Quality Control principles.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Proven ability to design robust QA frameworks, including scorecards, performance grids, audit routines, and escalation pathways.
  • High analytical capacity: you convert both quantitative data (CRM, metrics, dashboards) and qualitative observations (field, demos) into actionable insights.
  • Experience with CRM platforms, site/system usage tracking, and understanding of how systems impact commercial behavior.
  • Hands-on mindset and physical presence: comfortable conducting field visits, in-person assessments, and working closely with on-the-ground teams.
  • Strong communication skills, with assertiveness to raise operational gaps and collaborate across functions to solve them.
  • A mindset of continuous improvement, with proven results in bringing quality insights into actionable interventions (training, KB updates, process/system refinements).

QC Inspector Water Alternate Gas (WAG) Manifolds - Brazil

We are seeking a highly experienced QC Inspector to support fabrication activities for subsea WAG (Water Alternating Gas) manifolds and associated foundations. Based residentially in Rio de Janeiro, this role will oversee contractor quality performance during fabrication, ensuring strict compliance with project specifications, international codes, and HSE standards. This is a senior‑level inspection role requiring deep expertise in welding, CRA materials, and advanced NDT techniques within subsea or offshore fabrication environments.

  • Monitor welding of CRA materials including Super Duplex, Inconel 625, Alloy 59, and F22
  • Identify, report, and manage non‑conformities; stop work where required
  • Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action development
  • Prepare detailed weekly inspection and quality reports
  • Liaise closely with site representatives, welding engineers, and materials specialists
  • Support audits and follow‑up on corrective action closure
  • Ensure full compliance with HSE requirements and quality standards at all times

Candidate Profile

  • 15+ years’ experience in welding inspection within subsea, offshore, or oil & gas fabrication
  • Strong experience with WAG manifolds or subsea production systems preferred
  • Certified Welding Inspector (CSWIP 3.1 / 3.2 or equivalent CWI certification)
  • NDT Level 2 certification (UT & PAUT, RT, DPI required)
  • Extensive experience with CRA materials and advanced welding processes
  • Strong ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical specificationsFluent in English (Portuguese is advantageous)
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and stakeholder communication skills

Unlike competitors that offered one-size-fits-all solutions, we committed to developing best‑of‑breed products tailored to the distinct needs of our clients. Our approach combines expert‑driven design with exceptional flexibility to address even the most complex requirements, all while maintaining a steadfast focus on product excellence, relationship management, and superior service quality.

You will own lead ingestion, enrichment, and sourcing efforts while partnering closely with sales leadership to ensure pipeline health, data quality, and visibility into performance. This is a foundational role on the growth team with clear exposure to sales strategy, tooling, and performance metrics.

Sales Operations & Data Integrity

  • Maintain clean, accurate, and enriched CRM data
  • Ensure lead and account records are consistently updated and standardized

Reporting & Dashboards

  • Build and maintain sales dashboards and reporting to track
    • Lead volume and source
    • Conversion rates
    • Pipeline coverage
    • Activity metrics
  • Provide regular reporting and insights to sales leadership
  • Support forecasting and pipeline reviews with accurate data

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Leadership to align on pipeline goals
  • Provide feedback on lead quality and campaign effectiveness
  • Support Account Executives by ensuring qualified, well‑researched leads

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Experience working with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Self-starter who thrives in a fast‑moving, early‑growth environment
  • Interest in B2B SaaS, HR technology, or sales operations is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary Range: Competitive Compensation Package
  • Bonus: Performance‑based bonus tied to pipeline and data quality metrics
  • PTO: Generous unlimited PTO and holiday schedule
  • Growth Opportunity: Direct exposure to sales strategy, tooling decisions, and leadership

Why This Role Matters

This role is critical to ensuring viaPeople’s sales team operates with clarity, consistency, and momentum. You’ll help power the front end of the revenue engine while providing the insights leadership needs to scale efficiently.

medtechrec is partnered with a growing, privately held global medical device organisation specialising in sports medicine to recruit a Product Specialist to support continued expansion across Brazil.

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people-led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Position Overview

The Product Specialist acts as the key link between the companys product portfolio, its commercial partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject-matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted.

Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Key Responsibilities

Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Serve as the regional product expert, maintaining in-depth knowledge of product features, clinical applications, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends to support pricing strategy and commercial decision-making.
  • Provide data-driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go-to-market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with distributors, partners, and end-user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field-based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high-growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long-term career progression.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy.

Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location

Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing.

Leadership and Accountability

This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.

Responsibilities

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

A NAS IT está em busca de um Analista de Suporte N2 com perfil técnico e analítico, capaz de atuar em ambientes corporativos de missão crítica. O profissional será responsável por diagnosticar, resolver e documentar incidentes de nível intermediário e avançado em redes, servidores, segurança e conectividade, além de apoiar o time N1 e contribuir para a evolução contínua dos ambientes sob gestão. Esperamos um profissional autônomo, proativo e comunicativo, com domínio em Mikrotik, Fortinet, Zabbix, Grafana e soluções UniFi (Ubiquiti), além de boa compreensão de arquiteturas em nuvem e boas práticas de segurança.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar no suporte de 2º nível, assumindo chamados escalonados e incidentes de maior complexidade;
  • Diagnosticar e resolver falhas em redes LAN/WAN, servidores e serviços corporativos;
  • Configurar e administrar roteadores Mikrotik, com foco em roteamento dinâmico (OSPF/BGP), Load Balance, Failover, QoS e segurança;
  • Implementar, gerenciar e otimizar firewalls Fortinet (FortiGate), com análise e relatórios via FortiAnalyzer;
  • Gerenciar e manter monitoramento proativo com Zabbix e Grafana, incluindo alertas, KPIs e dashboards de desempenho;
  • Instalar e configurar Access Points UniFi (Ubiquiti), realizando o gerenciamento via UniFi Controller e integração com VLANs e redes segmentadas;
  • Realizar troubleshooting de conectividade, latência, VPNs e balanceamento de carga;
  • Criar e manter políticas de backup, restore e documentação de ambientes;
  • Gerenciar Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPOs e permissões de acesso;
  • Apoiar a equipe N1, fornecendo direcionamento técnico e validando correções aplicadas;
  • Executar tarefas de automação, scripts e integrações que otimizem a operação;
  • Contribuir com a padronização e evolução dos ambientes de TI sob gestão da NAS IT.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo ou cursando em Redes de Computadores, Segurança da Informação, Gestão da Tecnologia da Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em suporte técnico ou infraestrutura corporativa;

Conhecimento avançado em

  • Mikrotik RouterOS – roteamento dinâmico (OSPF/BGP), Load Balance, Failover, QoS, firewall e VPN;
  • Fortinet FortiGate e FortiAnalyzer – políticas, UTM, SD-WAN, VPN, análise de logs e relatórios;
  • Zabbix e Grafana – configuração de templates, triggers, dashboards e alertas automatizados;
  • Ubiquiti UniFi – controladora, provisionamento de APs, VLANs e redes segmentadas;
  • Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, File Server e políticas de grupo (GPOs);
  • Microsoft 365, Azure e ambientes híbridos em nuvem;
  • Windows Server, Linux e virtualização (VMware/Hyper-V).

Diferenciais

  • Certificações: MTCNA / MTCRE, Fortinet NSE 3+, Zabbix Certified Specialist, UniFi Network Specialist;
  • Experiência com PowerShell, automação de tarefas, API e scripts de integração;
  • Vivência em ambientes gerenciados (MSP/NOC/SOC);
  • Conhecimento em políticas de segurança da informação e LGPD;
  • Inglês técnico intermediário.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas;
  • Capacidade de documentar e padronizar procedimentos técnicos;
  • Boa comunicação e postura profissional com clientes corporativos;
  • Foco em melhoria contínua e colaboração com o time.

Benefícios

  • Trabalho home office em escala programada;
  • Vale Transporte ou auxílio deslocamento;
  • Ambiente de inovação, aprendizado contínuo e crescimento profissional.

title: Senior Director, Nature Fund Advisory
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is based in Arlington, VA, Colombia, Peru, or Brazil and offers remote or hybrid work flexibility. Amid growing consensus that the protection, restoration, and improved management of ecosystems can provide at least 30% of the climate mitigation needed to limit warming to 1.5 °C, CI has set ambitious targets to realize the potential of Natural Climate Solutions (NCS). A key mechanism for unlocking this potential is driving investments to NCS projects that generate meaningful climate impact and financial returns, including improved forest management of working natural and plantation forests (climate‑smart forestry; CSF) and other NCS types.

The Nature Fund Advisory team acts as impact advisors to private and public investors looking to deploy return‑seeking capital into NCS projects in ways that deliver tangible climate, community, and ecological outcomes. The team establishes ESG and impact criteria, conducts due diligence on potential investments, and carries out annual impact monitoring for our client partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate and project manage a cross‑divisional team with expertise in NCS, ESG, carbon, monitoring, finance, and other relevant skills to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Oversee the delivery of high‑quality due diligence results and related investment memos in coordination with partners.
  • Define functional processes, protocols, and formats, and continually iterate fund‑ and project‑level best practices to ensure robust due diligence and underwriting that results in an accurate understanding of the risks and opportunities presented by diverse investment opportunities, and promotes CI’s objectives of driving resources to high‑quality NCS with speed and scale.
  • Provide investment recommendations to CI’s investment committee representative, in cases where CI participates in fund governance.
  • Develop program strategies, objectives, work plans, and performance metrics.
  • Monitor, measure, interpret, and share results on a regular basis.
  • Develop a cadre of qualified third‑party professionals with the appropriate, field‑tested experience to conduct accurate due diligence on innovative forest management systems in challenging contexts worldwide.
  • Directly oversee and ensure program compliance with CI policies, funding agreements, and local requirements.
  • Articulate needs for technical capacity and manage, resource, and recruit the team as necessary to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Position CI as a recognized and sought‑after subject‑matter expert.
  • Hold conferences and learning events to share CI’s expertise, best practices, and amplify success with key audiences.
  • Serve as a trusted and visible point of contact for CI.
  • Champion opportunities for program and staff growth and development.

Support fundraising and external engagement

  • Support the development of major public (GEF, GCF) fundraising proposals and advise on public funding programs with substantial return‑seeking NBS project components.
  • Provide strategic thought leadership, including engagement at international forums, engagement with government, and serving as an external spokesperson for CI.
  • Develop and maintain high‑level relationships with key external partners, including NGOs, local communities, and private developers; identify and engage a network of forestry and agricultural companies, technical partners, and local and international NGOs; facilitate monitoring and verification, high‑quality technical standards, and appropriate community engagement and other safeguards that contribute to a robust NCS investment framework.

People and Resource Management Responsibilities

  • Directly supervise program and project staff, including overseeing the work of external partners.
  • Manage proposals and budgets, and ensure that activities performed by team staff are compensated in budgets with funds and partners.
  • Ensure compliance with donor requirements and CI policies.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • This is a full‑time position.
  • Local and/or international travel of 30% or more, often to remote locations and in difficult travel and working conditions.
  • Flexibility in work schedule required to accommodate time‑zone differences between the Arlington, VA office, and international field offices located in Europe, Asia‑Pacific, Africa, and Latin America.
  • Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in forestry, ecosystem management, environmental science, or another relevant field.
  • 10 or more years of professional experience, including program and project management experience, and 5 or more years supervising multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of forestry and other nature‑based climate solutions.
  • Experience with sustainability and environmental programs and certification standards that address carbon, energy, water, biodiversity, social, and sustainable forest management, e.g., Forest Stewardship Certification (FSC), Verified Carbon Standard (VCS), Gold Standard, Climate Community and Biodiversity (CCB).
  • Demonstrated experience with carbon standards for ARR and REDD+ projects, e.g., VCS, Goldstandard, Art Trees.
  • Knowledge of international climate mitigation policies and programs, e.g. Paris Agreement, the Kyoto Protocol, the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).
  • Expertise and understanding of proper management of greenfield and brownfield forestry and other NCS investments.
  • Evidence of a focus on collaboration and a strong network of individuals and institutions in NCS and forestry, including experience in convening and coordinating a broad range of individuals.
  • Experience with social and environmental safeguards and their application in the forestry sector.
  • Demonstrated track record of working effectively with multicultural, multidisciplinary teams to produce concrete results, including a strong capacity to navigate diversity, equity, and inclusion challenges and opportunities.
  • Ability to build and maintain strong and positive relationships across the organization.
  • Ability to manage and organize multiple projects with competing priorities and different timelines.
  • Excellent oral and written skills in English.
  • Superb technical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail, commitment to delivering products to exacting quality standards, organization, and time management skills.
  • Proven leadership skills and success in effectively inspiring and engaging diverse work groups in a multicultural environment.
  • Proven ability to multitask, meet priorities, and work in a fast‑paced environment with changing priorities with limited supervision.
  • Clear understanding of when and how to involve leadership and other programs to resolve challenges and achieve results.

Preferred

  • Graduate degree.
  • Ability to communicate in any one of the following: Spanish, Portuguese, French, Bahasa, or Mandarin.

To apply for this position, please submit a resume and cover letter.

Conservation International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We believe in hiring based on merit and qualifications, ensuring a fair and inclusive hiring process for everyone.

title: Executive Assistant BRA (Remote)
description:
An Executive Assistant (EA) provides high-level administrative support to executives, senior leaders, or company founders, ensuring their schedules, communications, and daily operations run smoothly . This role acts as a strategic partner, enabling executives to focus on decision-making and leadership responsibilities while the EA manages essential organizational and logistical tasks behind the scenes.

Typical responsibilities include coordinating complex calendars with multiple time zones, organizing and prioritizing meetings, preparing agendas, and ensuring executives are fully briefed ahead of engagements. Executive Assistants also arrange travel itineraries —including flights, accommodations, and transportation—while anticipating potential issues and providing contingency plans.

Beyond scheduling, EAs are often responsible for drafting and editing correspondence , preparing high-quality reports, presentations, and briefing documents , and managing internal and external communications on behalf of the executive. Handling confidential and sensitive information with discretion is critical, as is maintaining a professional demeanor when liaising with board members, clients, and other stakeholders.

An effective EA also monitors project timelines , follows up on action items, and acts as a gatekeeper—managing requests for the executive’s time and attention while balancing competing priorities. They often identify opportunities to streamline processes, implement productivity tools , and enhance the efficiency of the executive office.

Success in this position requires exceptional organizational skills , keen attention to detail, adaptability in fast-paced and high-pressure environments, and excellent communication abilities. The most effective Executive Assistants combine administrative expertise with strategic thinking, becoming an indispensable partner in the achievement of organizational goals.

A Social Media Manager is responsible for building, managing, and expanding a company’s presence across multiple social media platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), TikTok, and emerging channels. This role goes beyond simply posting content—it involves crafting a cohesive brand voice , designing and executing data-driven content strategies , and ensuring consistent messaging across all touchpoints.

Daily responsibilities often include planning editorial calendars , creating engaging text, image, and video content, scheduling and publishing posts, and actively interacting with followers to foster an engaged online community. A Social Media Manager also monitors industry trends, platform algorithm changes, and competitor activity to adapt strategies proactively.

Equally important is performance analysis —tracking metrics such as reach, engagement, click-through rates, and conversions to assess campaign effectiveness and inform future decisions. This requires proficiency with analytics tools, an understanding of paid advertising, and the ability to translate data insights into actionable improvements.

Success in this position demands strong communication skills, creativity, adaptability, and a deep understanding of digital marketing principles . A great Social Media Manager not only amplifies brand awareness but also drives audience loyalty and contributes directly to achieving broader business goals.

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

The Assistant Registrar for Records and Registration is responsible for the interpretation and application of student records policies, grade processing, registration functions, and the overall accuracy and integrity for the production and maintenance of academic records for all students. This position will serve as a primary contact point for student records inquiries, transfer credit evaluation and processing, enrollment, and registration. With an emphasis on service, efficiency, and use of technology, the Assistant Registrar will assist in streamlining overall processes and services for the records and transfer credit functions of the Office of the Registrar.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for providing supervision for various functions and work units. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and coordinates the work of these functions. Performs staff evaluations and makes recommendations regarding pay and/or performance.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, staff and students. External contacts include vendors, contractors, visitors, alumni and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assists in the operational functions related to enrollment & registration including registration permissions, overrides, waitlist, and batch registration.
  • Collects, records, maintains, and reports academic records in accordance with FERPA and university best practices (i.e., enrollment data, athletic eligibility, and completion data).
  • Manages transfer credit evaluation and processing using AACRAO transfer credit best practices.
  • Manages progress toward degree completion requirements and compliance for student athletes in accordance with NCAA, MEAC and University rules.
  • Produces academic standing and Dean’s list reports for review by the Provost’s Office and various schools and colleges.
  • Oversees grade reporting process (i.e., requests, changes of grades, and incomplete grades).
  • Supervises organization of archived records and transcripts.
  • Supervises and ensures accurate reporting of enrollment/degree verification processing for student insurance needs, student loan deferment documents and National Student Clearinghouse requests.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves problems with student records activities.
  • Develops and delivers point‑of‑use training to faculty and academic unit staff.
  • Supervises the management of Office of the Registrar email account.

Core Competencies

  • Experience with complex student information systems, course registration, curriculum and enrollment planning software (i.e., Banner, Colleague, Workday).
  • Experience in understanding administrative registration matters across higher education.
  • Strong understanding of best practices in student registration and records and understands the role of the Registrar in strategic enrollment management and student success.
  • Ability to analyze and interpret academic records and make independent decisions and judgments in accordance with Howard University policy.
  • Ability to manage and adhere to tight deadlines and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to set a high standard of professionalism by providing high quality customer services to the general public, students, faculty and staff.
  • Detail‑oriented and customer service and compliance‑focused.
  • Proven record of accountability and follow‑through.
  • Ability to effectively communicate with a wide range of individuals and constituencies in a diverse community.
  • Strong knowledge of all standard computer applications, including Microsoft Office products, with advanced level skills in Microsoft Excel as it applies to data management.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred. Minimum of 3 years of managerial experience in a registrar’s office or closely related enrollment. Management professional at a higher education institution.

Expected Salary Range

$65,000 - $75,000
